panel.name: panel_local_asset
panel.string: Rez a new in-world copy of this mesh (a client-side preview; nothing is uploaded).
Apply this to the selected object (all faces), or only the face(s) picked with Select Face.
No meshes yet. Click "Add..." to load a .dae, .gltf or .glb model.
No animations yet. Click "Add..." to load a .bvh or .anim file.
No textures yet. Click "Add..." to load an image file.
No materials yet. Click "Add..." to load a .gltf or .glb material.

button.name: add_btn
button.label: Add...
button.tool_tip: Load a file from disk to preview it locally -- nothing is uploaded.

button.name: upload_btn
button.label: Upload...
button.tool_tip: Upload the selected file to Second Life through the standard upload (with its L$ cost confirmation).

button.name: unload_btn
button.label: Unload
button.tool_tip: Free this asset from memory but keep it in the list as a dimmed entry you can reload. For a mesh this also derezzes its in-world copies.

button.name: remove_btn
button.label: Remove
button.tool_tip: Forget this file entirely and remove it from the list.

button.name: select_btn
button.label: Select in World
button.tool_tip: Select the rezzed copy and open Build to edit it (does not move the camera).

combo_box.name: attach_point_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Attachment point to wear the preview on.

button.name: attach_btn
button.label: Attach...
button.tool_tip: Wear a copy of this mesh on your avatar at the chosen attachment point.

check_box.name: include_joints_check
check_box.label: Joint Positions
check_box.tool_tip: Bake the mesh's joint-position overrides into its skin (for fitted bodies that need them). Off matches the upload preview default. Changing this reloads the mesh.

combo_box.name: anim_target_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Play on your own avatar, or on the selected animated object.

button.name: play_btn
button.label: Play
button.tool_tip: Play the selected animation on the chosen target.

button.name: stop_btn
button.label: Stop
button.tool_tip: Stop the animation on the chosen target.
